title: Greeny — one garden, one connected story
source: Greeny source deck, slides 6–7; existing Greeny case-study interface

shots.label: Meet the garden
shots.title: Your garden, always in reach.
shots.copy: Introduce one miniature garden. Plants and devices belong to the same place from the first frame.
shots.alt: Greeny garden tile with three planting beds, a fruit tree, a path and connected garden devices.
shots.direction: Wide three-quarter view. Hold the composition while the opening title becomes readable.

shots.label: Sense
shots.title: Understand the garden.
shots.copy: Bring the integrated sensor into focus. It reads soil moisture, temperature, air humidity and light.
shots.alt: The same garden turned slightly, with a highlighted fork-shaped sensor and a connection to its hub.
shots.direction: Turn the land 12 degrees. Add one sensor cue and a restrained connection to the hub; keep the rest of the scene quiet.

shots.label: Respond
shots.title: Care that follows a signal.
shots.copy: Show the sprinkler watering the bed. Irrigation can be triggered by a sensor threshold or a schedule.
shots.alt: The garden turned further, with short arcs of water flowing from the sprinkler into the planting beds.
shots.direction: Continue the same turn to 24 degrees. Sensor cues settle, then the sprinkler activates. Keep plant size unchanged.

shots.label: Control
shots.title: Keep the garden in reach.
shots.copy: The garden settles beside the existing Greeny app interface, linking the physical devices to monitoring and remote control.
shots.alt: The same connected garden settled in its final three-quarter view.
shots.direction: Finish at 28 degrees. Move the garden aside in the website layout and reveal the real app interface. Continue into the case study.
